description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AmqpErrorException' that wraps an AMQP error, providing methods to retrieve the error and convert it to an ErrorCondition. It is used within the org.eclipse.hono.util package to handle AMQP-related errors.

classes.name: AmqpErrorException
classes.description: A final class extending RuntimeException that wraps an AMQP error, encapsulating error details and providing conversion to ErrorCondition.

methods.name: AmqpErrorException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a Symbol representing the error and a description message.

methods.name: AmqpErrorException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with an error String, converting it to a Symbol, along with a description message.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the Symbol representing the AMQP error associated with this exception.

methods.name: asErrorCondition
methods.description: Converts this exception's error and message into an AMQP ErrorCondition using ProtonHelper.
